contentBlocks.body: Small helpers are easier to test and reuse. Instead of hiding every step inside one large function, compose focused helpers for cleaning, filtering, and formatting.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Why are small pure helpers useful?

choices: They are easier to test and combine
They make code run only once
They remove the need for variables
payload.answer: They are easier to test and combine
payload.explanation: Focused helpers make behavior easier to verify and reuse.
